name: skill-publisher-expert
description: Build reusable Skills for WorkBuddy, Trae, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Hermes and more. Generate WorkBuddy experts, adapt skill packages, troubleshoot imports and prepare GitHub releases. Additional platforms require compatibility assessment.

displayName.zh: 多平台技能生成发布专家

displayDescription.zh: 为WorkBuddy、Trae、Codex等平台生成技能与专家，支持跨端适配、打包排错与发布
displayDescription.en: Build reusable Skills for WorkBuddy, Trae, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Hermes and more. Generate WorkBuddy experts, adapt skill packages, troubleshoot imports and prepare GitHub releases. Additional platforms require compatibility assessment.
